visual_review: Direct original review shows a close foreground pink-gray stone tabletop with dense dark grains, a rounded thick edge, a shallow concentric perimeter groove and a dull surface. Matching cylindrical stools show a rougher side finish; the pedestal has broad turned transitions. Useful for the hilltop stone topic table surface and edge treatment. The garden is Hamilton Gardens in New Zealand, not Tubi; the distant pavilion/moon gate does not identify the site. Daylight color and photographic grain are observation references, not the nighttime palette or a shipped scan.
